# External reference meshes (not printed)

Meshes of bought parts, in assembled position, used by the animations in `anim/`.

| file | what | source |
|---|---|---|
| `pi.stl` | Raspberry Pi 5 board | official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP model (© Raspberry Pi Ltd), exported from the reference component in `rpi5_window_cam.solidcraft` (occurrence 118). See "Reference models" in `CLAUDE.md`. |
| `camera3.stl` | Camera Module 3 board | official Camera Module 3 STEP model (© Raspberry Pi Ltd), from the reference component in `rpi5_window_cam.solidcraft` (occurrence 346). Split out of a whole-design export by position and thinned (0.3 mm vertex clustering, ~24k triangles). |
